svg.title: Withdrawal flow: USDC / USDT0 / EURC on Stellar to fiat
svg.desc: Sequence diagram of a withdrawal between the client, Stablecue, the Anchor Platform partner and the Stellar network, with the Stablecue intent state shown at each stage.
svg.text: Withdrawal flow: USDC / USDT0 / EURC on Stellar to fiat
signed in the client’s own wallet
KYC details, bank account for payout
signed in the client’s own wallet
Every state transition is appended to the immutable event log: intent_id → partner transaction id → Stellar tx hash.
Solid arrows: requests and actions. Dashed arrows: responses and callbacks. Arrow colour = sender (teal client, indigo Stablecue, amber partner, grey Stellar).
